text:
Maria: quick check — we still double-write embeddings to all regions on create, right? that's killing egress + storage for big tenants :grimace:
Sam: yeah it's the current flow. primary write + fanout async to replicas. cheap for small tenants but not for high-volume ones.
Kevin: can we switch to write-once + on-demand replicate? i.e., only replicate when a local query misses and residency allows.
Maria: that was one of the proposals in the rfc but concern was read-latency spike during first misses and cold-start thundering.
Anya: also residency/legal constraints: some tenants require embeddings to never leave EU. so replication policy needs per-tenant flags.
Sam: proposal: per-tenant policy enum {LOCAL_ONLY, ASYNC_REPLICATE, ON_DEMAND_REPLICATE}. default ASYNC_REPLICATE for legacy.
Kevin: +1. add a lightweight bloom filter per shard to detect probable presence before fetching remote to avoid a lot of roundtrips.
Maria: love the bloom idea. need safe fallback if bloom false-negative => fetch remote. acceptable.
Anya: what about reconciliation? if we do on-demand replicate we might create inconsistent duplicates or different vector ids across regions. need id canonicalization.
Sam: canonical id = sha256(tenant_id + model_id + input_hash) stored as embedding_id. if remote replica creates same id, it's a no-op; if different version then versioned metadata handles it.
Anya: ok, but privacy/PII — for some EU tenants we cannot compute input_hash outside region. so canonicalization must be deterministic without shipping raw inputs. could compute hash locally and send just the hash to replicate.
Kevin: note: sending hash still leaks some collision signal but it's fine given legal review. We'll put a flag to disable cross-region hashing for strict customers.
infra-bot: perf note: on-demand replicate will change traffic pattern to more cross-region reads. we should simulate 99th percentile tail before rolling out.
ops-bot: action item created: ENG-PLAT-582 simulate on-demand with bloom prefilter.
Sam: also propose a background reconciler: nightly job that compares embedding counts + sample similarity checks and emits a delta to repair missing replicas. low-priority, rate-limited.
Maria: can we sketch quick pseudo?
Sam: ```
for tenant in tenants:
  if tenant.policy == "ON_DEMAND_REPLICATE":
    for id in sample_local_ids(tenant):
      for region in tenant.allowed_regions:
        if not exists_remote(id, region):
          replicate(id, region)  # rate limit + cost cap
```
Anya: add safety: only replicate if last_write < 24h to avoid copying stale/unreviewed embeddings.
Kevin: and add cost cap per tenant to billing to prevent runaway charges.
Maria: sounds actionable. next: can someone put a short design doc + perf sim plan? I can shepherd legal flagged tenants list.
Anya: i'll draft the doc, include bloom false-positive math and reconciliation cadence.
Sam: I'll run synthetic sim vs current fanout and produce cost delta.
infra-bot: logging note: tag replicated_by = "on_demand_reconciler" or "async_fanout" on objects for audit.
Maria: perfect. thanks all :raised_hands: 
Sam: timeline? can we aim POC in 2 weeks?
Anya: yes for doc + perf baseline this week, POC in 2 weeks sounds doable.
Kevin: i'll help with test harness.
ops-bot: issue ENG-PLAT-583 created for reconciler implementation tracking.
Maria: closing thread — keeping policy model flexible is key here. we'll sync in arch sync on Friday.
